problem: After charging the battery of a PC, the percentage of charge decreases at a rate of $c(t)=100\cdot {5}^{-0.2t}$ percent per hour, where $t$ is the time, in hours, since the battery had completed its charge. What will be the rate of decrease after $5$ hours?

feedback.problem: The decay rate $M$ of muons in a beam traveling at high speed can be modeled by the function $M(t)=2\cdot {e}^{-2t},$ where $t$ is the time, in microseconds, since observations started. What will be the decay rate of the muons after $0.5$ microseconds? Round your answer to three decimal places.
feedback.worked_solution:
The function $M(t)$ models the decay rate for the particles $t$ microseconds since observations started.

Thus, the decay rate of the muons after $0.5$ microseconds is

$$
\begin{aligned}M(0.5) & =2\cdot {e}^{-2(0.5)} \\  & =2\cdot {e}^{-1} \\  & ≈0.736.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the decay rate of the particles is $0.736$ muons per microsecond.
